_about: Strings where a wrong reading costs something: a key left on the clipboard, a key git could commit, a value overwritten. For these, a translation carries the idea below in the shortest, plainest, most directive words the language has. It does not need to follow the English catalog's wording. Short sentences. One instruction per sentence. No idiom.
detail.noEnvYet: There is no .env file yet. One will be created. Only you can read it.
name.replace: The current value will be replaced.
name.replaceIn: The current value in %1 will be replaced.
git.notIgnored: Git does NOT ignore this file.
git.tracked: Git tracks this file. If you save here, the key would be committed.
git.otherVcs: This folder uses %1. This plugin does not check %1.
confirm.replace.title: Replace the value in %1.
confirm.replace.sub: A value is already there. The old value will be deleted.
confirm.ignore.title: Add %1 to .gitignore in %2.
confirm.ignore.sub: Git does not ignore this file. Git could commit the key.
confirm.vcs.title: Not checked: %1
confirm.vcs.sub: This plugin checks only git. Make sure yourself that the other system does not track this file.
result.clip.changed.sub: You copied something else after the key.
result.clip.failed.title: THE KEY IS STILL ON THE CLIPBOARD.
result.clip.failed.sub: The clipboard was not cleared. Copy other text now.
result.history.unchecked.title: Clipboard history was NOT checked.
result.history.unchecked.sub: The history file could not be read or changed. Open clipboard history with Super+Ctrl+V. Delete the entry that contains the key.
result.failed.title: Nothing was saved.
result.detail.never: The key was never shown, never typed, and never put in a command.
error.cannot-write: Cannot write to %1. The file or its folder is read-only.
error.tracked: Git tracks %1. If you save here, the key would be committed. First run git rm --cached on that file.
error.not-ignored: Git does not ignore %1. Git could commit the key. Add the file to .gitignore. Then save again.
error.not-found: The key could not be read from %1.
error.no-key: There is no key on the clipboard.
keys.exposed: Files that git does not ignore: %1
places.copy.sub: The copy is marked as sensitive. Clipboard history does not keep it. Paste it where you need it.
copy.done.body: It is on the clipboard, marked as sensitive. Clipboard history keeps no copy.
notice.noKey.how: On the website, press Copy. Then press this hotkey again.
peek.quote: The clipboard text contains a single quote ('). A .env file cannot store it safely.
notice.tracked.title: Git tracks %1.
notice.tracked.why: If you save here, the key would be committed. Adding the file to .gitignore does not change that.
notice.tracked.fix: First run git rm --cached on that file. Then save again.
notify.clip.failed: THE KEY IS STILL ON THE CLIPBOARD.
